collection_goal: Continuously collect and curate skills and tools that improve prior authorizations, clinical documentation, scheduling, billing readiness, and patient communication workflows.

Standard Practice builds voice AI for healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM) teams. Its AI agents place and handle outbound phone calls to insurance payers to automate administrative work — claim status follow-up, benefits verification, prior authorization, and EDI enrollment — so billing teams can scale collections and get paid more, faster.

Silna Health is a healthcare automation platform that handles prior authorizations, benefit checks, eligibility verification, and insurance monitoring upfront so providers can confirm patients are clear to receive care.

Ruma Care is a healthcare software company that streamlines the prior authorization process for biologic and infusion medications in infusion clinics. Python-based mapping engine that transforms legacy hospital data into standardized HL7 FHIR R4 resources. Focused on healthcare data interoperability and EHR compatibility.

Advanced Clinical Decision Support System is a Python–Flask app that integrates AI with EHR (FHIR/HL7) for diagnosis, 5-level triage, and real-time patient assessment. With 90%+ accuracy, live analytics, and a modern dashboard, it demonstrates how AI enhances clinical decision-making.

Augmedix is a San Francisco-based health technology company providing ambient AI medical documentation (AI scribe) services that capture patient-clinician conversations and generate clinical notes so that physicians can focus on patient care instead of EHR data entry.

MediScribe AI is an AI-powered healthcare documentation assistant that converts doctor-patient conversation recordings into structured medical records. It reduces manual documentation work for doctors by automatically generating SOAP notes and important clinical insights.
HIPAA-compliant Discord bot for instant ICD-10 lookups, medical billing codes, and searchable practice management knowledge base. Keep your clinic organized.

An AI agent analyzes the procedure description, determines the correct billing codes, and updates a Google Sheet. This cut out data entry and improved billing accuracy.

Python-based medical document automation workflow that extracts structured data from clinical notes, including patient info, diagnosis codes, provider details, and treatment plans. Includes validation checks, confidence scoring, and JSON output for reporting, billing, and workflow automation.
